title.narrative: Developing and implementing a youth influence structure

description.narrative: We aim to strengthen youth influence in decision making in our partnership. Basing on the prior experience and ideas from the participants, we intend to review the Youth Forum guidelines and structure; lay down new guidelines on youth influence youths governance, planning, implementation and monitoring of our partnership activities; discuss how the youth influence structure is anchored in both organizations to strengthen this; and design a road map for the Youth Forum�s youth influence activities; and discuss recruitment of volunteers. This will be done during a five days of boot camp, with volunteer and staff from both organisations. Afterwards YLDC will facilitate elections for the new youth structure in the four YBs outside of Kampala.
